record.field:
This serves as an official Warning Notice issued to the Athletics Federation of UAE for failure to maintain proper governance records as required under Article 14 of the Sports Federations Governance Framework.

The federation is required to rectify all governance documentation deficiencies within 30 days of this notice and provide evidence of compliance to the Ministry.

Failure to comply may result in escalated sanctions including financial deductions or suspension of support disbursements.
Penalty for late post-event report submission — World Athletics Championships 2026

A Financial Deduction of AED 10,000 is hereby imposed on the Athletics Federation of UAE in accordance with Ministry Policy on Post-Event Reporting (Section 8.3).

This deduction arises from the failure to submit the post-event report for the World Athletics Championships 2026 (Tokyo) within the mandatory 15-day window. The report was overdue by 22 days.

The deduction will be applied against the next approved support payment disbursed to the federation.
